name: Doorstep
short: The page the customer opens on their phone after they have booked.
long: Where the job is, who is coming, the paperwork, what is left to pay and somewhere to ask a question — all on one phone-width page. A business-view panel sits alongside it, and pressing "On the way" over there starts the customer's ETA counting down and walks the van along a drawn route line on this side.
proves: That is one fewer "what time is he coming?" phone call, every single job.
features: Seven-step job timeline from booked to paid, with the engineer, his van reg and a live ETA that counts down while he is on the way
Business view with status buttons that drive the customer page in real time — the route line and countdown start the moment it is pressed
Quote, invoice and certificate as document cards, each with a download that goes to a saved state and stays saved
Demo card payment against the balance with the deposit already taken, and a message thread the office answers
story: Customers ring because they cannot see anything. Giving them one link that answers where, who, what and how much turns the anxious afternoon phone call into a page they check once.
